changelog: Your calendar and your documents now belong to you. Events you create stay on your PC and sync straight to your phone - Google and Outlook are optional mirrors that are switched OFF unless you turn them on, and a locked event never leaves whatever the setting. If someone emails you an invite, import the .ics and it becomes a real event you can edit, with no account connected; you can subscribe to a calendar feed the same way, and share your own calendar back out as an .ics any calendar app can open. New: point DensAssistant at folders of documents and they become searchable memory alongside your meetings and notes. Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and iCloud are detected for you - those files are already synced to your PC, so nothing is uploaded and no account is linked.
